lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Prime Minister Mark Carney said a "very good trade arrangement" with the United States is possible but those talks are far more complex than the trade discussions Canada is having with China and other partners, The Canadian Press reports.
Trump meets Xi and Putin in China with nuclear arms and two wars on the table, The Canadian Press reports.

A Surrey, B.C., landscaping company is giving its employees the day off on Thursday when the much-hyped Grand Theft Auto VI video game finally releases, in what has been billed as perhaps the biggest entertainment launch ever, The Canadian Press reports.
Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 per share, valuing the AI giant at $1.5 trillion, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.

bds.h: 'If the U.S. doesn't want to do a deal, we're busy,' Carney says of ongoing trade talks
bds.lede: Prime Minister Mark Carney said Wednesday that Canada is willing to sign a mutually beneficial deal with the Americans, but if U.S. President Donald Trump can't agree to those terms, then Ottawa will continue on its current trajectory: Aggressively diversifying away from the United States.
rows: SHENZHEN — Prime Minister Mark Carney said a "very good trade arrangement" with the United States is possible but those talks are far more complex than the trade discussions Canada is having with China and other partners.

Prime Minister Mark Carney said Wednesday that Canada is willing to sign a mutually beneficial deal with the Americans, but if U.S. President Donald Trump can't agree to those terms, then Ottawa will continue on its current trajectory: Aggressively diversifying away from the United States.
Prime Minister Carney said on Wednesday that "if the US doesn't want to do the deal, we're busy", as he eyes alternatives for Canada's auto sector in Beijing.
